questions.question: Known malicious activity has been contained, but validation is still running. The customer asks, ‘Is the environment safe now?’ Choose a reassuring answer that does not overpromise.
options: The environment is safe based on the checks completed so far, although validation is continuing.
Known malicious activity has been contained. Validation is still under way, so we are not treating the wider environment as fully cleared yet.
Current indicators show no active threat, and the remaining checks are only precautionary.
The immediate threat is contained. Validation continues to confirm that no related activity remains.
questions.explanation: La opción D comunica el estado positivo confirmado y mantiene abierta la validación sin usar safe ni guarantee. A llama seguro al entorno; B introduce wider environment fully cleared, un estándar distinto; C minimiza las comprobaciones restantes.
questions.translation: La amenaza inmediata está contenida. La validación continúa para confirmar que no queda actividad relacionada.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Customer questions
questions.question: An executive presses: 'Did they steal data, yes or no?' The evidence is inconclusive. What is the best spoken response?
options: We do not know yet; there is evidence of staging but not enough to prove exfiltration.
The answer is probably no, because we have not identified an outbound transfer.
We cannot give a reliable yes or no: we found data preparation, but no confirmed transfer.
We cannot confirm data theft, although the staging activity means it remains likely.
questions.explanation: Cannot give a reliable yes-or-no answer reconoce la petición y explica dos estados distintos. Las otras suenan abruptas, convierten ausencia en probably no o califican likely sin base suficiente.
questions.translation: En este momento no podemos dar una respuesta fiable de sí o no: encontramos indicios de preparación de datos, pero ninguna transferencia confirmada.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Customer questions
questions.question: The customer asks what ‘likely’ means in your assessment. Give the clearest explanation.
options: 'Likely' means we have reasonable confidence, although some evidence is still missing.
Here, 'likely' means the evidence favors that explanation over the alternatives, but it is not confirmed.
'Likely' simply means the explanation has not been ruled out.
It is our leading assessment, and the term carries the same meaning as high confidence.
questions.explanation: La opción B define likely de forma comparativa y conserva la diferencia con confirmed. A usa reasonable sin criterio; C define possible, no likely; D equipara dos dimensiones que no son necesariamente idénticas.
questions.translation: En este caso, «probable» significa que la evidencia favorece esa explicación frente a las alternativas, pero no está confirmada.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Customer questions
questions.question: During slide review, a stakeholder wants every caveat removed. Push back constructively while still simplifying the message.
options: The caveats must stay because every unresolved point belongs on an executive slide.
I can shorten the caveats, but removing any of them would always make the conclusion inaccurate.
We can simplify the wording, but we should keep any caveat that materially changes how the finding is interpreted.
We should preserve one uncertainty statement, regardless of which limitation is most relevant.
questions.explanation: La opción C acepta simplificar y conserva solo las salvedades materialmente relevantes. A pretende incluir todo; B trata todas las salvedades como igualmente necesarias; D usa una cantidad arbitraria en vez de relevancia.
questions.translation: Podemos simplificar la redacción, pero debemos mantener cualquier salvedad que cambie de forma material cómo se interpreta el hallazgo.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Customer questions
questions.question: A client asks whether a vendor is responsible before the vendor review is complete. Which reply is neutral?
options: The evidence currently points to the vendor, although their review is still ongoing.
We are investigating whether the vendor connection contributed to the incident.
The vendor link is one line of inquiry, but evidence is insufficient to assign responsibility.
It would be premature to blame the vendor until all third-party evidence is available.
questions.explanation: One line of inquiry mantiene neutralidad; assign responsibility responde a la pregunta sin blame. Las otras apuntan al vendor, hablan solo de contributed o usan blame de forma confrontativa.
questions.translation: La conexión del proveedor es una línea de investigación, pero todavía no tenemos pruebas suficientes para atribuir responsabilidades.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Customer questions
questions.question: The customer asks why the SIEM did not detect the activity earlier. The cause is still unknown. Respond openly and naturally.
options: The SIEM missed it because the relevant data source was not fully onboarded.
We're reviewing the rule logic, data coverage, and alert handling. We haven't yet confirmed the cause of the delay.
There are many possible reasons, so it is too early to discuss the detection delay.
No technical failure has been identified, which suggests the issue was probably operational.
questions.explanation: La opción B nombra las líneas de revisión y declara con naturalidad que la causa sigue sin confirmarse. A fija una causa; C evita una pregunta legítima; D convierte la ausencia de hallazgo en una inferencia operativa.
questions.translation: Estamos revisando la lógica de la regla, la cobertura de datos y la gestión de alertas. Todavía no hemos confirmado la causa del retraso.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Customer questions
questions.question: During Q&A, someone asks about a system that was not in the evidence set. Give a helpful answer without implying it was clean.
options: We did not identify issues with that system, although it was outside the primary scope.
The main findings probably apply to that system even though it was not reviewed.
We didn't review that system, so I can't draw a conclusion about it yet. I'll confirm it separately.
There is no indication that the finding extends to that system based on the current scope.
questions.explanation: La opción C separa no revisado de sin problemas y ofrece un seguimiento concreto. A y D sugieren un resultado negativo fuera de alcance; B extrapola los hallazgos sin evidencia.
questions.translation: No revisamos ese sistema, así que todavía no puedo sacar una conclusión sobre él. Lo confirmaré por separado.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Customer questions
questions.question: In front of the customer, a manager asks for your ‘best guess.’ Replace guessing with a properly labeled professional assessment.
options: If I had to guess, I would say phishing caused the compromise.
Our assessment favors credential theft. It remains an assessment rather than a confirmed fact.
The most likely scenario is credential theft, so that is what we should tell the customer happened.
Our best estimate is that phishing caused the compromise, pending further evidence.
questions.explanation: La opción B sustituye guess por una evaluación profesional y mantiene exactamente su grado de certeza. A y D aceptan adivinar y añaden phishing; C convierte una hipótesis principal en el relato de lo ocurrido.
questions.translation: Nuestra evaluación favorece el robo de credenciales. Sigue siendo una evaluación y no un hecho confirmado.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Customer questions
questions.question: A client challenges a finding: 'That IP belongs to our provider, so it cannot be malicious.' What is the best response?
options: Ownership matters, but does not determine whether the activity was authorized or malicious.
Provider infrastructure can still be compromised, so the IP should remain under investigation.
The IP ownership lowers the risk, but we need the provider to validate the activity.
That may explain the connection, although we should confirm what service used the address.
questions.explanation: Ownership matters reconoce el contexto aportado por el cliente; does not determine whether the activity was authorized or malicious separa propiedad y conducta. Las otras opciones especulan sobre compromiso del proveedor, reducen el riesgo o aceptan una explicación antes de identificar el servicio.
questions.translation: La propiedad importa, pero no determina si la actividad estaba autorizada o era maliciosa.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Customer questions
questions.question: You do not know the answer to a detailed briefing question. Respond with confidence, ownership, and a concrete follow-up.
options: I can't answer that accurately right now. I'll verify it in the source data and include it in the next update.
I cannot answer at the moment, but someone on the investigation team may already know.
That detail is still being analyzed, so I would prefer not to discuss it.
Let me take that away and come back when every aspect has been confirmed.
questions.explanation: La opción A reconoce el límite, asume la acción y fija el canal de seguimiento. B desplaza responsabilidad; C no promete respuesta; D espera una confirmación total innecesaria y no concreta cuándo se informará.
questions.translation: Ahora mismo no puedo responder con precisión. Lo verificaré en los datos de origen y lo incluiré en la próxima actualización.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Decisions and next steps
questions.question: You cannot confirm compromise, but the potential impact is high and password reset is low-cost. Which recommendation fits the uncertainty?
options: The password should be reset because the account is likely compromised.
Although compromise is unconfirmed, resetting the password will remove the immediate risk.
We suggest a password reset to ensure that any stolen credentials can no longer be used.
We recommend resetting the password as a precaution while the investigation continues.
questions.explanation: As a precaution vincula acción proporcional con incertidumbre. Las otras declaran likely, prometen remove risk o presuponen stolen credentials.
questions.translation: Recomendamos restablecer la contraseña como medida de precaución mientras continúa la investigación.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Decisions and next steps
questions.question: A server may be compromised, but isolating it would stop a critical service. Which next step is best framed?
options: The server should remain online until compromise is confirmed, with enhanced monitoring in place.
We recommend delaying isolation because the evidence is not yet strong enough to justify disruption.
The safest option is to isolate the server, although the service owner must accept the operational impact.
Given the disruption risk, monitor immediately while the business owner and incident lead assess isolation.
questions.explanation: Given... reconoce trade-off; increasing monitoring es medida inmediata; business owner and incident lead asigna decisión. Las otras convierten confirmación en umbral, deciden retrasar o llaman safest sin balance.
questions.translation: Dado el impacto operativo del aislamiento, recomendamos aumentar de inmediato la monitorización mientras el responsable de negocio y el líder del incidente evalúan la decisión de aislar.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Decisions and next steps
questions.question: The investigation cannot recover missing logs. Which next step reduces uncertainty rather than pretending to close it?
options: Use the available logs to reach the most likely conclusion and record that some evidence was unavailable.
Document the gap, seek corroboration, and state the residual uncertainty in the final assessment.
Close the gap through interviews and threat intelligence where technical evidence is missing.
Complete the investigation with a qualified conclusion based on the remaining sources.
questions.explanation: Document, seek corroborating evidence y state residual uncertainty forman un proceso completo. Las otras fuerzan conclusión, prometen close the gap con fuentes indirectas o saltan a completion.
questions.translation: Documentar la carencia de visibilidad, buscar pruebas que la corroboren en otras fuentes e indicar la incertidumbre residual en la evaluación final.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Decisions and next steps
questions.question: A hypothesis is plausible but has not produced a testable prediction. What should the team do?
options: Gather more evidence until the hypothesis can be confirmed or rejected.
Keep the hypothesis open and compare it with any new indicators that emerge.
Define predicted evidence, then test for findings that could support or weaken the hypothesis.
Assign a provisional confidence level and revisit it after further analysis.
questions.explanation: Define predictions y design checks convierte una idea plausible en hipótesis comprobable. Las otras piden más evidencia sin dirección, esperan indicadores o puntúan antes de probar.
questions.translation: Definir qué pruebas predeciría la hipótesis y después diseñar comprobaciones que puedan reforzarla o debilitarla.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Decisions and next steps
questions.question: Containment is complete, but the root cause remains uncertain. Choose the closure approach that keeps the unresolved work visible.
options: Close the incident now and move root-cause analysis to an untracked follow-up if time allows.
Maintain containment, complete the root-cause work, and track the remaining uncertainty as an open action.
Keep the incident open until the root cause is proven beyond doubt and every possible risk is removed.
Close the incident once containment is validated, without carrying the uncertain root cause into closure records.
questions.explanation: La opción B separa contención de causa raíz y conserva la incertidumbre como acción trazable. A y D permiten que el punto abierto desaparezca; C exige una certeza y una eliminación total del riesgo poco realistas.
questions.translation: Mantener la contención, completar el análisis de causa raíz y registrar la incertidumbre restante como una acción abierta.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Decisions and next steps
questions.question: A new log source could resolve a key question, but onboarding will take two weeks. How should you present the decision?
options: We should wait for the new log source because it may provide the evidence needed for confirmation.
The source could reduce uncertainty. We should weigh that against a two-week delay to the final assessment.
Onboarding the source would improve confidence, although it would delay the investigation outcome.
The assessment can proceed now, with the new source used later to validate the conclusion.
questions.explanation: Could reduce uncertainty y weigh that against formula el trade-off sin decidirlo de antemano. Las otras ordenan esperar, describen impacto sin criterio o asumen que la nueva fuente validará una conclusión ya emitida.
questions.translation: La nueva fuente podría reducir la incertidumbre, pero debemos decidir si su valor esperado justifica retrasar dos semanas la evaluación final.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Decisions and next steps
questions.question: You need to prioritize two open questions. One affects legal notification; the other is technically interesting but low impact. Which rationale is best?
options: The legal question has higher priority because it may create regulatory exposure.
We should prioritize the question with the greatest potential impact, even if the technical issue is easier to solve.
We should address the notification question first because resolving it changes an immediate business decision.
The notification issue is time-sensitive, while the technical question can remain open for the final report.
questions.explanation: Changes an immediate business decision conecta investigación y decisión sin hacer valoración legal. Las otras presuponen exposición regulatoria, usan potential impact genérico o asignan el otro punto al informe sin conocer plazos.
questions.translation: Debemos abordar primero la cuestión de notificación porque resolverla cambia una decisión empresarial inmediata.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Decisions and next steps
questions.question: Two root causes remain plausible and both call for the same control improvement. Recommend action without pretending the cause is settled.
options: Recommend the shared control improvement now, while making clear that it addresses both plausible causes without confirming either one.
Delay remediation until one root cause is confirmed, so the control has a definitive justification.
Apply the control only to the cause the team currently prefers and close the alternative.
Implement the control because both hypotheses prove that the same weakness caused the incident.
questions.explanation: La opción A permite reducir riesgo ahora y conserva abiertas ambas causas. B aplaza una mejora común; C cierra una alternativa sin prueba; D convierte hipótesis en demostración y una mejora compartida en causa única.
questions.translation: Recomendar ahora la mejora de control común, dejando claro que aborda ambas causas plausibles sin confirmar ninguna de ellas.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Decisions and next steps
questions.question: A detection has false positives but covers a high-impact technique. Which recommendation reflects uncertainty and operational cost?
options: Tune the detection until false positives fall to an acceptable level without reducing coverage.
Maintain the rule because missing the high-impact technique would be a greater risk than alert noise.
Keep the detection enabled, refine it, and verify that fewer false positives do not remove meaningful coverage.
Run the detection in monitoring mode while the team determines its true-positive rate.
questions.explanation: Keep, refine, and measure propone ciclo verificable y no promete cobertura intacta. Las otras asumen que tuning no reduce cobertura, deciden trade-off sin datos o cambian modo sin explicar impacto.
questions.translation: Mantener la detección activa, ajustar la lógica y medir si la reducción de falsos positivos conserva una cobertura significativa.

questions.topic: Explaining evidence and uncertainty · Decisions and next steps
questions.question: The final report needs a conclusion despite missing proxy data. Select the closing statement that is clear, natural, and properly qualified.
options: Credential theft was the access method, although missing proxy logs prevent us from proving every step.
We conclude that credential theft enabled access, subject to the general limitations in this report.
The access method remains unknown, so the report should avoid identifying a leading explanation.
The evidence favors credential theft as the access method. Without the proxy data, this remains an assessment rather than a confirmed fact.
questions.explanation: La opción D identifica la explicación mejor respaldada, nombra la carencia concreta y etiqueta el resultado como evaluación. A y B presentan la vía de acceso como conclusión; C oculta una evaluación útil pese a que la evidencia sí favorece una hipótesis.
questions.translation: La evidencia favorece el robo de credenciales como método de acceso. Sin los datos del proxy, esto sigue siendo una evaluación y no un hecho confirmado.
